approval: Owner ruling 2, 2026-11-07; shared point-force T3 v2

point.definition: Neutral cap top center plus 0.5 cap radius along shell pushing direction, projected onto actual cap top; fixed in stick link coordinates.
point.geometry_method: Highest cap collision component supplies neutral XY bounding-box center and mean X/Y half-span radius; at the prescribed XY, the topmost native cooked-SDF zero crossing defines top Z. Record all dimensions and stick-local point.

criteria.hold_tilt_scoring: Minimum tilt over all complete hold ticks must be >=1 degree; otherwise fixture invalid, not a physical conclusion.
criteria.low_scoring: For Fv<6.66N, maximum unchanged signal and raw travel ratio over hold must be <=0.05.
criteria.positive_scoring: For Fv=8.14N, minimum unchanged signal and raw ratio over last 0.5s hold must be >=0.95.
criteria.unloaded_scoring: Maximum signal and raw ratio during the 0.5s observation after unloading must be <=0.05; final endpoint also reported.

application: Native articulation apply_forces_and_torques_at_position in world coordinates after Lab write_data_to_sim; point follows stick body link pose, force directions follow fixed shell frame. No sphere, no contact servo, no joint position/target writes during trajectory.
solver_policy: Unchanged inherited Isaac preview: TGS, 4ms, articulation 32/1, default scene iteration bounds, external_forces_every_iteration=false; read back actual values.
comparison: Run identical old/new conditions; baseline signal failures are descriptive. No threshold changes or tuning to observed physics scores.
stop_policy: Stop on execution error, invalid fixture, or a new-model physical gate failure; old-model signal failures are descriptive. Frozen T4 retains first historical-passing regression stop rule. At most three repair attempts from ruling 2.
visualization: Five force-level PNGs, old/new x left/right native geometry, fixed application point marker, horizontal/vertical arrows and shaft direction or point trajectory; no sphere. Copy to Pictures/v042_review/isaac/t3v2.
